title: Hicham El Guerrouj: King of the Mile - Ultimate Deep Dive
imageHint: El Guerrouj breaking the mile world record in Rome's Stadio Olimpico, 1999
description: The most comprehensive exploration of the greatest middle-distance runner in history - from his Moroccan training secrets to his legendary world records and Olympic double triumph.

questions.explanation: This record, set in Rome, remains untouchable after 25+ years
